correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim the exact support maximum localizes the high-width event to the two poles, entirely on the two-circle contact branch. In squared radial coordinate s the deficit is s+c(phi)s²+O(s³) uniformly, with average c=7/32; inversion and normalized spherical integration give 1/8−7/64=1/64. Uniform convergence of the scaled radial boundaries and planar densities gives total-variation convergence, with the two weights exactly equal by reflection. The original lower calculation was also checked: dσ=dθdy and four square charts give 2√2/π and a half-area switching mark. No uploaded code was executed.
residual_risks: Numerical estimates are finite diagnostics reported in the source; the correctness decision uses the analytic proof.
